email_delivery_description: Delivery to a recipient server does not confirm inbox placement or that an email was read. Missing events do not resend accepted messages.
email_delivery_reason_hard_bounce: Recipient server permanently rejected the email. Check the address.
email_delivery_reason_complaint: Recipient reported spam. An operator must review this with the email provider.
email_delivery_reason_suppressed: Provider suppression is active. An operator must review this with the email provider.
email_delivery_reason_rejected: Email provider permanently rejected the send. Check sender and recipient configuration.
email_delivery_reason_temporary: Recipient server temporarily rejected delivery. The provider handles delivery retries.
email_delivery_reason_timeout: The send timed out. Provider acceptance is unknown.
email_delivery_reason_expired: The retry window ended without a confirmed send.
email_delivery_reason_irrelevant: Sending stopped because the notification is no longer applicable or permitted.
email_delivery_warning: For failed emails, check the recipient address before starting a new send. Suppressed addresses require review with the email provider; the app cannot force delivery.
email_delivery_resend_failed: The email request failed. Try again later.
email_delivery_invitation_accepted: Invitation for {email} accepted by the email provider.
